desc:
A cooperative sandbox zombie survival game with base building mechanics and weapon customization. This game is still in its Alpha stage so expect bugs and other issues. 

controls 
LMB - shoot (repair in build mode) 
RMB - aim (damage in build mode) 
E - melee 
G (5-6) - grenade 
R - reload (hold to rotate in build mode) 
Q - cycle sights 
V - cycle firing mode 
T - toggle/cycle all attachment modes 
F - interact 
`/~ - free mouse/manual attachment mode toggle (open buildable menu in build mode) 
B - enter build mode 
shift - sprint 

Paid access price will lower as development milestones are reached. Your cash will be reset & levels/weapons records will be reduced by 80% once the game fully releases.
